descriptionTemplates.value: A practical, well-used piece -- shows its age but still does the job.
Simple in make, but clearly built by someone who knew what they were doing.
Has a story behind it that isn't written down anywhere.
Not much to look at, but reliable in a way that matters more than looks.
Carries small marks of wear that suggest real use, not display.

flavorTemplates.value: {name} has passed through more hands than its current owner probably knows.
Nobody's quite sure where {name} originally came from.
{name} isn't valuable in the usual sense, but somebody clearly thought it was worth keeping.
There's a small detail on {name} that suggests it meant something to someone, once.
{name} turns up in more than one old story, always at the edges.
{name} survived whatever wrecked everything around it, which is its own kind of story.
The manufacturer stamp on {name} belongs to a company that stopped existing years ago.
{name} keeps showing up in accounts that otherwise don't agree on anything.

designNotes.value: Procedurally rolled, narrative-first (this world has no rarity/pricing system) -- worth a manual polish pass.
